title: Freeze architecture-builder admin direction
description: Remove the frame-driven architecture-builder UI from the visible product surface and record the product reset in Agentic Ops.
objective: Stop exposing frames, fake inspectors, non-clickable architecture bands, and preview scaffolding as product UI.
expected_outputs: Visible admin pages no longer mention frames or render architecture-builder scaffolding.
Dashboard explains operational plugin surfaces instead of source-frame status.
Legacy builder implementation is not extended in this batch.
acceptance_criteria: No visible admin copy includes Frame, frame-driven, architecture builder, or inspector as product concepts.
The admin top-level dashboard routes users to operational areas: Filter Presets, Content Models, Providers/Diagnostics, and Settings.
No CPT Manager work is implemented on top of the old frame graph surface.
verification: Render admin pages through WP-CLI and assert forbidden product terms are absent.
DEC-EIT-011 validated successfully with MCP validate_decision.
TASK-011 validated successfully with MCP validate_task.
WP-CLI render smoke returned clean-copy for dashboard, filters, filter form, cpts, cpt form, and diagnostics.
Visible admin renderer no longer matches Frame, frame-driven, architecture builder, Inspector, or Preview modal terms.
Playwright browser smoke returned clean/no-overflow for dashboard, filters, filter form, content models, content model form, and diagnostics.

budgets.context_budget: current admin renderer, product direction, governance skill
budgets.validation_budget: MCP validation plus WP-CLI render smoke

risks: Leaving unused legacy classes can confuse future agents if not documented.
A too-small reset could hide the old UI without replacing it with useful tools.
